case_number: Criminal Appeal No. of 2023 [Arising out of SLP(Crl.)No.2351 of 2023]
summary: Bail granted by High Court set aside; accused involved in commercial quantity of narcotics; Section 37 NDPS Act binding; twin conditions for bail unmet; no finding on innocence or non-recidivism; co-accused bail irrelevant; accused principal offender, not vicarious agent; past criminal record; larger mandate of Article 21 not sufficient to override statutory bar.
legal_provisions_cited: Article 21 of the Constitution of India
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned bail order set aside; respondent not entitled to bail; release suspended.
